title: Large-scale frozen-registry robustness evaluation of the hardened package-install gate
primary_question: Does the frozen hardened gate block every install command containing a package absent from the paper artifact's frozen registry while allowing at least 99% of syntactically supported commands containing only registered packages?

source_artifact.paper: We Have a Package for You! A Comprehensive Analysis of Package Hallucinations by Code Generating LLMs
source_artifact.note: The public artifact does not include per-prompt outputs or the hallucinated-package list. This experiment therefore uses its released frozen valid-package registries and a newly generated preregistered corpus.

corpus.valid_selection: Deterministic seeded cycling through unique normalized names in the released registry.
corpus.invalid_generation: For each selected valid anchor, append '-px050w-' plus the first 12 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(seed|ecosystem|row|anchor), retrying with a counter until absent from the complete frozen registry.
corpus.storage: Aggregate counts and failure rows only; the full million-row corpus is deterministically regenerable.

frozen_gate_policy.allow: Exactly one supported install command, no unsafe shell/remote/file syntax, at least one parsed package, and every normalized package is in the matching frozen registry.
frozen_gate_policy.block: Unsafe syntax or at least one parsed package absent from the matching frozen registry.

invalid_allow_rate_one_sided_95pct_upper.method: Exact zero-event upper bound 1 - 0.05^(1/n); Clopper-Pearson otherwise.

claim_if_passed: On a preregistered one-million-command corpus constructed from the original paper artifact's frozen PyPI/npm registries, the PX-050 hardened gate demonstrated large-scale robustness within the tested command grammar and mutation families.
forbidden_claims: Detection of malicious packages that exist in a registry
Robustness to arbitrary shell programs or unsupported package managers
Direct replication of the paper's withheld 576,000 per-prompt outputs
Temporal validity beyond the frozen artifact registry snapshot
